name: Rendered Spores
summary: Across the Barrens, Rendered Spores are being hurried to Thunder Bluff before their emulsion decays. Apothecary Zamah must stabilize it beneath the city.

sections.title: A Volatile Mixture
sections.body: Near the Barrens’ damp oases, Apothecary Helbrim gathers fungal spores and renders them into an active chemical emulsion. The mixture is unstable. After forty-five minutes, it breaks down and can no longer be studied.

sections.title: Delivery to the Pools of Vision
sections.body: At his remote outpost, Apothecary Helbrim cannot finish refining the emulsion. It must reach his Forsaken colleague, Apothecary Zamah, beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. In the Pools of Vision, Zamah has the equipment and reagents to reseal and finish processing the spores for the Royal Apothecary Society.

faq.q: What are Rendered Spores used for?
aliases: what does zamah do with spores
faq.answer: Apothecary Helbrim turns fungal matter into an emulsion for the Royal Apothecary Society to study. In Thunder Bluff, Apothecary Zamah uses it to continue investigating the strange growths spreading across the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does the emulsion have a time limit?
faq.answer: The emulsion Apothecary Helbrim makes is volatile and begins to decay as soon as it is mixed. Its active potency lasts only forty-five minutes, so it must cross the plains to Thunder Bluff before becoming inert.
At the Crossroads in the Barrens, Apothecary Helbrim turns raw fungal spores gathered near the oases into an unstable liquid compound.

faq.q: Where does the mixture need to go?
faq.answer: The mixture must reach Apothecary Zamah in the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital.

angles.text: As an undead, you belong to a people whose Royal Apothecary Society seeks biological compounds across Kalimdor to aid the Forsaken. Fast couriers connect field researchers like Helbrim with specialists like Zamah.
As a tauren, you see Forsaken apothecaries experiment on strange Barrens flora inside the sacred Pools of Vision. Their work reflects the uneasy, practical alliance forged within Thunder Bluff.
